surface: Daily Report and shared field submit shell
exact_symptom: All reports synced control obstructed the sticky submit action on phone/tablet layouts
root_cause: QueueStatusPill used a fixed viewport-bottom offset with no shared contract for FormShell sticky-footer height
smallest_safe_repair: Publish sticky-footer height from FormShell and offset QueueStatusPill above it with safe-area-aware spacing
evidence: Pre-fix 390x844 overlap metrics; post-fix responsive matrix; /app/test_reports/iteration_149.json

exact_symptom: Legitimate field reporter received 401 on incident submit
root_cause: Incident frontend client omitted field_leadership headers and backend outer gate only accepted Safety/Admin/PM before capability checks
smallest_safe_repair: Add narrow field-capable incident gate for create/patch/evidence/submit helpers and move incident client back onto the shared api + field_leadership header scope
evidence: Direct preview API proof; backend logs; /app/test_reports/iteration_149.json

exact_symptom: Health failure emails were firing immediately after the 60-minute backup target instead of allowing a realistic operator buffer
root_cause: Admin system-health backup card used the RPO target as both warning and red-alert threshold in practice
smallest_safe_repair: Keep 60-minute warning target but move red-alert / failure-email threshold to 75 minutes via BACKUP_HEALTH_ALERT_THRESHOLD_MINUTES
evidence: /api/admin/system-health backup card detail shows target <= 60m; alert > 75m; live preview currently red only because age is 135m
